contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::closeCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstances()->any(candidate: CashDesk|candidate.Id = cashDeskID)
	precondition:
		CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(candidate: CashDesk|candidate.Id = cashDeskID and
		candidate.IsOpened = true) and
		self.CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true
	postcondition:
		cashDesk.IsOpened = false and
		self.CurrentCashDesk = cashDesk and
		result = true
}
